title: Industry Networks and the Geography of Firm Behavior
authors: William Grieser; James Paul LeSage; Morad Zekhnini
eligible_reason: Bayesian spatial autoregressive / spatial Durbin models (MATLAB, LeSage toolbox) with convex combinations of geographic, TNIC and supply-chain weight matrices. The quasi-experiment (Tariff.m) uses 3-digit SIC tariff cuts (sic3_tar4, sic3_diftar4, cut) as regressors in SDM models with FF48 or SIC3 fixed effects and spatial spillovers; no TWFE DiD with a staggered binary treatment and unit plus year FE.
design_notes: samplecreate.do builds the Compustat-based sample; main.m and Tariff.m estimate SAR/SDM via MCMC. Regression extractor found no Stata/R regression commands (empty regressions file). Data (Compustat, Hoberg-Phillips TNIC, Pierce-Schott tariffs) are proprietary or third-party and not included; only a directory listing of the original data folder.

ineligible_specs.reason: spatial econometric models; tariff shocks as continuous/indicator regressors without unit and year TWFE DiD structure

software_notes: MATLAB (jplv7 spatial econometrics toolbox) with Stata sample construction
screener_notes: Full-text 'Callaway' and 'difference-in-differences' hits are not reflected in any TWFE code in the package.
